wire.headline: Utility Firms Report Mixed Quarterly Results
sentences: Revenue rose by 7% year-on-year to reach 4.26bn GBP for the quarter ending 30 September.
Pre-tax profit decreased by 12% to stand at 310m GBP.
The company announced plans to cut 850 jobs, representing approximately 6% of its workforce.
Two gas plants, located in Wales and Kent, are scheduled to close by March 2027.
CEO Marian Holt stated that cost pressure has been sharper than anticipated.
Ofgem has opened an investigation into the company's billing system.
The dividend was maintained at 12.4p per share.
Shares fell by 4.2% during morning trading.
